subject: Interest: Redwood GitHub connector — demo & integration questions
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question before booking a demo

Hi Lauren,

I signed up for Redwood last week (self-serve) and poked around the GitHub connector docs. We’re an open-source maintainer org and have a few integration questions before we schedule a demo:

- Does the connector support private repo webhook events when installed on an org?
- Can Redwood run inference on PR comments from forks (we allow CI from forks but with limited permissions)?
- Any hardened guidance for rate limits / event batching for active repos (we have a repo that sees ~300 PRs/day during big spikes)?

I can share a repo link and a screenshot of our webhook settings. Would appreciate a 30-min technical demo with someone who can speak to webhook scopes and private-repo behavior.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
OpenForge — Platform & Integrations
https://openforge.dev
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00

Hi Alex — welcome and great questions.

Short answers up front: yes to private repo webhooks (via org install), we can process PR comments from forks depending on your GitHub settings, and we have batching knobs to smooth spikes — but I want Ben (SE) to confirm specifics for your workloads.

Would any of these windows work for a 30-min technical demo this week?
- Wed 4/28 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 4/28 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 4/29 11:00–11:30 PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/lauren-b/redwood-demo-30m. Also please share the repo URL and the screenshot you mentioned so Ben can review ahead of time.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
SDR, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question before booking a demo — OpenForge technical prep

Hi Alex — thanks for the repo and screenshot, looking forward to the demo on Wed 4/28 14:00 PT. A few quick notes for the session so we can make the most of 30 minutes:

- Org install is preferred for maintainers who want a single install with minimal per-repo friction. We’ll walk through the exact OAuth scopes and show the least-privilege option.
- We do not persist raw webhook payloads by default; events are ingested and cached briefly for retry/diagnostics. If you need full retention for audit, we offer an optional retention export (we can discuss compliance options).
- For high PR volumes we recommend enabling our adaptive batching and prefix-level KV cache; I’ll demo a real workload profile and the batching slider.
- Please invite me to the meeting as: ben_carter@redwood.ai. If possible, add one of your engineers (Sam Huang) who knows the repo CI setup.

Prep checklist for you to drop in the invite or send before the demo:
- Confirm the org name and whether you prefer org vs per-repo installation
- Grant a read-only test repo or set aside a private test repo for the demo
- Any production data you want excluded (we can cover anonymization)

Attached: openforge-repo-access-screenshot.png

See you Wed — Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
